move_tensors_to_device: move nested dict or list of PyTorch tensors to a specified device like cuda or cpu
detach_and_copy_to_cpu: detach and copy nested dict or list of PyTorch tensors from GPU to CPU
wrap_module_for_gpu: wrap a PyTorch module with GPUWrapper to automatically move inputs to GPU and outputs to CPU
convert_module_list_to_gpu: convert a sequentially used ModuleList into a GPU-wrapped ModuleList that runs sub modules on GPU
review_GPUWrapper_class: review the GPUWrapper class that wraps a PyTorch module to run inference on GPU with CPU I/O
